## Running the database: the fuller list

**Governance**

- **A named data steward**, with a written mandate and a deputy, and a
  **network of validators** per species group. In Czechia the Nature
  Conservation Information System is set up in law (Act No. 364/2021 Coll.),
  which names its operator and its purposes, EU reporting among them.
  Here: [*legal basis and steward – to be confirmed*]{.underline}.
- **Data-sharing agreements** with every institution that sends or receives
  data: which data, how often, in what format, under which licence, and how
  sensitive records are handled.
- **A sensitive-species policy** with an owner and a review cycle: generalise
  the location in public; full precision for named users under agreement.

**Procedures**

- **SOPs and a data dictionary.** One written procedure for each flow
  (monitoring, trusted experts, citizen science); one definition for each
  field, with its Darwin Core term – the crosswalk opposite is its core.
- **A data management plan for every funded project**: format, schedule,
  licence and where the data are deposited – agreed at contract signature,
  checked at hand-over. The data, not the report, are the deliverable.
- **Raw data never overwritten**; provenance and a change history on every
  record. Persistent `occurrenceID` and `eventID`, never reused.
- **Backups** that run automatically, with at least one copy off-site, and a
  restore that has actually been tested.

**Publishing and people**

- **Metadata for every dataset in EML** (Ecological Metadata Language) – who,
  what, where, when, how, licence. GBIF's IPT writes it for you.
- **Clear licensing and citation** – CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC, stated per
  dataset; a GBIF DOI gives each dataset a citable identifier.
- **Regular public exports** – a versioned snapshot at fixed intervals, so an
  analysis can be repeated on the same data.
- **Training for data providers** – the forms, the checklist, what coordinate
  uncertainty means – and feedback to them on their own records.
- **Start simple, then iterate**: a checklist, one validated flow, one dataset
  on GBIF; then the next flow.

## Which standard, and how settled is it?

| Piece | Status |
|:---|:---|
| Darwin Core, Occurrence and Event cores | TDWG standard since 2009, maintained |
| Measurement or Fact (`dwc:`) | part of Darwin Core |
| Extended Measurement or Fact | from OBIS; registered with GBIF, not a TDWG standard |
| Humboldt Extension (`eco:`) | TDWG-ratified 28 Feb 2024; in GBIF's registry for the Event core; tool support still growing |
| GBIF taxonomy | now the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release; the old GBIF Backbone is frozen (last built 2023) |

## Key resources

- Darwin Core terms – <https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/>
- Humboldt Extension – <https://eco.tdwg.org/>
- Extended Measurement or Fact – <https://manual.obis.org/format_emof.html>
- GBIF IPT – <https://www.gbif.org/ipt> · manual <https://ipt.gbif.org/manual/>
- GBIF metadata profile (EML) – <https://ipt.gbif.org/manual/en/ipt/latest/gbif-metadata-profile>
- Catalogue of Life – <https://www.catalogueoflife.org/>
- PESI, the European taxonomic backbone – <https://www.eu-nomen.eu/portal/>
- Art. 17 reporting (Eionet) – <https://cdr.eionet.europa.eu/help/habitats_art17>
- *ndopred*, Red List metrics from occurrence records – <https://github.com/jonasgaigr/ndopred>
- This workshop – <https://github.com/jonasgaigr/kosovo-biodiversity-data-workshop-2026>

## Full crosswalk: survey spreadsheet → Darwin Core

One visit is an **event**; what was found on it are **occurrences**; anything
measured hangs from either as a **measurement**. Terms without a prefix are
Darwin Core; `eco:` is the Humboldt Extension; `dcterms:` is Dublin Core,
which Darwin Core uses for licence and rights.

```{=typst}
// Set in Typst rather than as a pipe table: the Darwin Core terms are long
// unbreakable identifiers, and a pipe table can neither put two of them on
// separate lines in one cell nor let a group heading span the row.
#let t(x) = text(font: "Consolas", size: 6.5pt, fill: rgb("#006B4D"), x)
#let grp(x) = table.cell(colspan: 3, fill: rgb("#EEF6E4"), text(font: "Franklin Gothic", fill: rgb("#006B4D"), x))
#table(
  columns: (21%, 50%, 29%),
  table.header([Your column], [Darwin Core term], [Note]),
  grp[Event – the visit],
  [Visit no.], t[eventID], [persistent, never reused],
  [Site / plot code], t[locationID], [from the site register],
  [Date, time], t[eventDate], [ISO 8601: 2026-06-18T21:30],
  [Latitude, longitude], t[decimalLatitude \ decimalLongitude], [decimal degrees],
  [Coordinate system], t[geodeticDatum], [e.g. EPSG:4326 (WGS 84)],
  [GPS accuracy (m)], t[coordinateUncertaintyInMeters], [mandatory],
  [Place name], t[locality], [as written in the field],
  [Method], t[samplingProtocol], [from a controlled list],
  [Plot size], t[sampleSizeValue \ sampleSizeUnit], [e.g. 25 · square metre],
  [Time spent, traps set], [#t[samplingEffort] or \ #t[eco:samplingEffortValue] \ #t[eco:samplingEffortUnit]], [Humboldt splits value and unit],
  [Target group], t[eco:targetTaxonomicScope], [what was searched for],
  [All targets recorded?], t[eco:isAbsenceReported \ eco:isTaxonomicScopeFullyReported], [what makes an absence usable],
  [Surveyor(s)], t[recordedBy \ eco:samplingPerformedBy], [person; team or body],
  grp[Occurrence – what was found],
  [Record no.], t[occurrenceID], [persistent, never reused],
  [Species], t[scientificName \ taxonID], [national checklist ID; crosswalked to PESI and GBIF],
  [Found? yes / no], t[occurrenceStatus], [present / absent],
  [Count], [#t[individualCount] or \ #t[organismQuantity] \ #t[organismQuantityType]], [e.g. 12 · individuals],
  [Life stage, sex], t[lifeStage \ sex], [controlled values],
  [Identified by], t[identifiedBy], [],
  [Checked by an expert?], t[identificationVerificationStatus], [free text in DwC – agree a national list],
  [Record type], t[basisOfRecord], [HumanObservation, PreservedSpecimen …],
  [Project, source], t[datasetName \ datasetID], [keeps the source visible],
  [Location generalised?], t[dataGeneralizations \ informationWithheld], [for sensitive species],
  [Remarks], t[occurrenceRemarks], [],
  grp[Measurement – linked by eventID or occurrenceID],
  [Water depth, cover %, …], t[measurementType \ measurementValue \ measurementUnit], [Extended Measurement or Fact],
  grp[Dataset – once, in the EML metadata],
  [Licence], t[dcterms:license], [e.g. CC BY 4.0],
  [Rights holder], t[dcterms:rightsHolder], [],
)
```
